items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Did Leo Wright play with you, Melvin's son? Was he too young then? Who? He's a kid. Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: He played there with me. I stayed in Lewiston after I left the California nightclub for a long time. That's four nights a week, man.
Yeah. Did Leo Wright play with you, Melvin's son? Was he too young then? Who? He's a kid. Oh, yeah.

Ron El Paso, just Melvin and his brother Lacey. Lacey, that's what I was about. Yeah, Lacey. Yeah, Lacey. Lacey long since his mind. We worked with them on and off, you know, at different times. Well, Lacey played what, Tano?
